stage: Tox-Prot final Gate C negative-overlap census
overlap_definition: Candidate negative excluded if it has any qualifying MMseqs2 hit to any of the 7,534 cleaned positive sequences at >=30% identity with >=80% shorter-sequence coverage, cov-mode 1.
interpretation: All three candidate pools remain above both frozen negative-support thresholds after positive-sequence overlap filtering. Candidate-negative supply is therefore not the experiment bottleneck.
